brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.evidence: The full base piece:0,0,0 was already on screen before I started. I didn't change it.

There's no hex-turbo-drawer-9000 in the catalog, and the search for 'turbo' found nothing. The base also has no drawer sockets, so I fitted nothing. Real alternatives: a classic, slide, swing, long or longbin drawer on a half base, or a notch or bay drawer frame between bases.

finish.summary: I couldn't fit a hex-turbo-drawer-9000 because no part by that name exists. A catalog search for "turbo" found nothing. The only drawer parts are notch drawer frames and bay drawer frames (single or double height). There are also drawers that sit on the cut face of a half base, in the styles classic, slide, swing, long and longbin. The one full base you already had on screen is unchanged and has nothing added. Putting a different drawer on it would be swapping the part you asked for without your say, so I didn't. If you'd like a real drawer instead, I can do either of these: swap in a half base and fit one of its drawer styles, or add a second base beside it and put a notch drawer in the gap between them. Tell me which, or give me the real name of the part you meant.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
